mapper.insert: INSERT INTO thumbnail (board_id, file_name, file_path, file_extension, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{board_id}, #{file_name}, #{file_path}, #{file_extension}, now(), #{created_by})
mapper.update: UPDATE FROM thumbnail SET file_name = #{file_name}, file_path = #{file_path}, file_extension = #{file_extension}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updated_by} WHERE board_id = #{board_id}
